ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, a promoter of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, disclosed a minor open market acquisition of 64,000 shares, increasing its stake from 33.42% to 33.45%. This negligible 0.03% increase does not materially impact the target company's ownership structure or control, merely reflecting a marginal consolidation of an already significant promoter holding. There are no immediate red flags, as this appears to be a routine regulatory disclosure.
